title: Upgrade app to Progressive Web App (PWA) for mobile installation

requirements.text: Convert the frontend into a Progressive Web App (PWA) by adding a Web App Manifest file (manifest.json or manifest.webmanifest) in the frontend/public directory. The manifest must include: app name ('AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice'), short name ('Unani PYQ'), start URL, display mode 'standalone', background color matching the parchment theme (e.g., #f5f0e8), theme color matching the deep teal accent, and icon references for at least 192x192 and 512x512 sizes. Reference the manifest in frontend/index.html via a <link rel='manifest'> tag.

quotes: upgrade the app to be a proper PWA (Progressive Web App)

acceptanceCriteria: A manifest.json file exists in frontend/public with all required PWA fields (name, short_name, start_url, display: standalone, background_color, theme_color, icons).
frontend/index.html includes <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'> in the <head>.
The app can be added to the home screen on Android (Chrome) and iOS (Safari) via the browser's native 'Add to Home Screen' prompt.
When launched from the home screen icon, the app opens in standalone mode without browser chrome.

requirements.text: Register a Service Worker in the frontend to enable offline support and caching. The service worker must cache all critical static assets (HTML, JS, CSS, images) on install so the app loads when the device is offline. Use a cache-first strategy for static assets and a network-first strategy for API/canister calls. Register the service worker in frontend/src/main.tsx or via a separate registration script loaded in frontend/index.html.
acceptanceCriteria: A service worker file (e.g., sw.js) is present in frontend/public.
The service worker is registered in the app entry point.
Static assets are cached on service worker install.
The app shell loads correctly when the device has no network connection.
Canister/API calls are attempted over the network and fail gracefully when offline.

requirements.text: Add PWA icon assets for the home screen and splash screen. Generate a 192x192 and a 512x512 version of the app icon (based on the existing app logo/Unani motif) and place them at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-192.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-512.png respectively. Reference these paths in the manifest icons array.
acceptanceCriteria: icon-192.dim_192x192.png and icon-512.dim_512x512.png are generated and placed in frontend/public/assets/generated/.
The manifest.json icons array references both files with correct sizes and type 'image/png'.
The icons display correctly on the Android home screen and iOS home screen when the app is installed.

requirements.text: Add the necessary meta tags to frontend/index.html for iOS PWA support: apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style (set to 'black-translucent' or matching the teal theme), apple-mobile-web-app-title, and apple-touch-icon pointing to the 192x192 icon. Also set the <meta name='theme-color'> to match the app's deep teal accent color so the browser toolbar matches the app theme on Android.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html contains <meta name='theme-color'> with the teal accent color value.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui).
Service worker must not intercept or cache ICP canister HTTP calls in a way that causes stale data or authentication failures.
All existing screens, navigation, and backend integration must continue to work unchanged.
nonGoals: Native mobile app (React Native, Flutter, or app store submission).
Background sync or push notification support.
Any changes to the backend Motoko actor.
Changes to quiz logic, question data, or existing UI screens.

required: Circular app icon with Unani medicine motif — ornate geometric arabesque border, central herb/vessel illustration on a deep teal background with gold accents (icon-192.dim_192x192.png)

Circular app icon with Unani medicine motif — ornate geometric arabesque border, central herb/vessel illustration on a deep teal background with gold accents, high resolution (icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
